question:
Fill in the blanks with the correct homophone.

________ of anything is destructive in nature.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Excess**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of HOMOPHONE is one of two or more words pronounced alike but different in meaning or derivation or spelling.
 
 
• Example: To, too and two.
 
 
 
• **In the given question, the correct word to use in the blank is "excess."**
 
• **Since, the blank implies that anything in more than required quantity is bad.**
 
 
• "Excess" means an amount or quantity that is more than necessary or desirable.(अधिकता)
 
 
• ​Example: Excess love is not always good for the children.
 
 
 
 
 
• It is a homophone of "access", "axes", and "axis".

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Access" means the ability or right to enter or use something.(पहुँच)
 
• "Axes" is the plural form of "axis", which refers to a straight line around which an object rotates.(कुल्हाड़ियों)
 
• "Axis" can also refer to a central point or line around which something is organized or revolves.(एक्सिस)
